en: Talks to Anthropic's Messages API and to endpoints that speak it.
text: 连接 Anthropic 的 Messages API，以及兼容该 API 的端点。

en: Talks to OpenAI-style chat completion endpoints: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Gemini, Groq, DeepSeek, Mistral and local servers.
text: 连接兼容 OpenAI 的 Chat Completions 端点：OpenAI、OpenRouter、Gemini、Groq、DeepSeek、Mistral 和本地服务器。

en: Talks to Gemini's own API (Interactions) for chat, transcription and voices: every audio format, Gemini 3's thought signatures carried exactly, its usage with cached and thinking tokens, a voice that streams, Google keeping the conversation between turns, so each sends only what is new, and Google Search on a paid key, its answer shown as Google gave it.
text: 通过 Gemini 原生 API（Interactions）提供对话、语音转文字和声音：支持所有音频格式，原样保留 Gemini 3 的思考签名，用量统计包含缓存和思考 token，声音可流式播放；对话由 Google 在轮次之间保留，所以每次只发送新内容；付费密钥还可使用 Google 搜索，答案按 Google 给出的原样显示。
note: Note: chat → 对话, as annai names the Chat ability (kindWords).

en: Phone quality, 8 kHz (about 0.8 MB a minute)
text: 电话音质，8 kHz（每分钟约 0.8 MB）

en: Full quality (the most data: about 4 MB a minute of speech)
text: 最高音质（数据量最大：每分钟语音约 4 MB）

en: Stream her voice, so she starts sooner (off: each sentence arrives whole first)
text: 流式播放她的声音，开口更快（关闭：每句完整收到后才播放）

en: Talks to Gemini's Live API: a voice conversation in one stream, both ways, for Koe.
text: 连接 Gemini 的 Live API，为 Koe 提供语音对话，听和说同时进行。

en: Talks to OpenAI's Realtime API: a voice conversation in one stream, both ways, for Koe.
text: 连接 OpenAI 的 Realtime API，为 Koe 提供语音对话，听和说都在同一条流中。

en: Talks to OpenAI's Responses API and to servers that speak it, OpenAI keeping the conversation between turns, so each sends only what is new, and the stored responses deleted when annai is told to.
text: 连接 OpenAI 的 Responses API 及支持它的服务器。对话由 OpenAI 在各轮之间保存，所以每轮只需发送新内容；收到删除指示时，annai 会删除已保存的回复。

note: Note: the plugin's name, as the screens and the Models note (1xx9c0t) say it.

en: Shows a PDF's pages as pictures to models that see photos but can't read PDFs, and draws a PDF's first page for its preview in any browser. It brings Mozilla's PDF.js, about 4.5 MB.
text: 把 PDF 的页面转成图片，交给能看照片但读不了 PDF 的模型；还会绘制 PDF 的第一页作为预览，在任何浏览器中都能显示。内含 Mozilla 的 PDF.js，约 4.5 MB。
note: Note: "brings" read as the package carries it, so 带有.

en: Any other server: an OpenAI-compatible one, a router or proxy, or a server you run. Give its address, and annai looks for what it offers, at no cost.
text: 其他任何服务器：兼容 OpenAI 的服务器、路由或代理，或你自己部署的服务器。填入地址后，annai 会检测它提供哪些功能，不产生费用。

en: A server that never streams sends each answer whole, so annai sees nothing of it until all of it has come: if long answers stop with "No output started in time.", raise the role's "Wait for the first words" in Settings → Models, and Settings → Voice → "Wait for her first words".
text: 不使用流式输出的服务器会一次性发来完整回答，在全部收到之前 annai 什么都看不到。如果长回答因“没有在限定时间内开始输出。”而中止，请调高设置 → 模型中该角色的“等待第一句”，以及设置 → 语音 → “等待她开口”。
note: Note: Quotes annai's own error (没有在限定时间内开始输出。) and the two settings' labels (等待第一句, 等待她开口) as annai's rows write them.

en: For servers that speak OpenAI's Responses API. Keeping the conversation on the server, so each turn sends only what is new, is off here until you turn it on: a server that ignores previous_response_id would answer without the conversation. If one refuses requests, try "phase": false, "nowRole": "user" or "encryptedReasoning": false in the tunables. Give a reasoning model its Reasoning levels on its page; without them it thinks without showing progress, and may run past the time limit.
text: 适用于支持 OpenAI Responses API 的服务器。在服务器上保存对话（这样每轮只需发送新内容）的功能在这里默认关闭，需要你手动开启，因为忽略 previous_response_id 的服务器会在看不到之前对话的情况下回答。如果服务器拒绝请求，可以在可调参数中试试 "phase": false、"nowRole": "user" 或 "encryptedReasoning": false。推理模型请在它的页面上设置推理级别；否则它思考时不会显示进度，还可能超时。

en: Give the address without /v1: Anthropic Messages adds /v1/messages itself.
text: 地址请不要带 /v1，Anthropic Messages 会自动加上 /v1/messages。

note: Note: 声音: the Voice ability, as annai's own kindWords (b1qn4p), not the Settings → Voice screen (语音).
Note: 实时语音 as annai's own Live voice (the realtime ability's kind); 语音 here is speech, not the glossary's voice (声音).

en: For a server that speaks OpenAI's Realtime API over a WebSocket, at this address plus /realtime. Add its models by id. annai gives the key as the browser's subprotocol, as OpenAI's own does.
text: 适用于通过 WebSocket 支持 OpenAI Realtime API 的服务器，地址为此地址后加 /realtime。请按 ID 添加模型。annai 会像 OpenAI 官方那样，把密钥作为浏览器的子协议发送。

en: The path is there; Test says whether a model there can listen.
text: 路径存在；那里的模型能否识别语音，请用“测试”确认。
note: Note: "listen" is a transcription model's job: 识别语音 reads better than a bare 听.

en: The path is there; Test says whether a model there can speak.
text: 路径存在；那里的模型能否朗读，请用“测试”确认。

en: Its model list names no voice, so it's added switched off.
text: 模型列表里没有声音模型，所以添加时就是关闭的。

en: Its model list names no transcription model, so it's added switched off.
text: 模型列表里没有语音转文字模型，所以添加时就是关闭的。

en: Blocked: it doesn't allow web apps (no CORS).
text: 被拦截：它不允许网页应用调用（没有 CORS）。

en: annai couldn't reach {0}. Check the address and your connection.
text: 无法连接 {0}。请检查地址和网络连接。

en: {0} doesn't allow web apps like annai to call it (no CORS headers), so annai can't use it from a browser. If it has a setting for the addresses allowed to call it (CORS), add annai's.
text: {0} 不允许 annai 这类网页应用调用（没有 CORS 标头），所以无法在浏览器中使用。如果它有允许调用的地址设置（CORS），请把 annai 的地址加进去。

en: annai found nothing at {0} that it can use. Below is why.
text: 在 {0} 上没有找到可用的内容，原因如下。

note: Note: 声音: the Voice ability, as annai's own row with the same key, not the Settings → Voice screen (语音).

text: 地址已更改，请重新检测。
密钥已更改，请重新检测。

en: Adding it, with what it needs…
text: 正在添加并安装所需插件…

en: annai only asked for the model list and sent an empty request to each known path. Nothing here costs money; Test sends real requests.
text: annai 只请求了模型列表，并向每个已知路径发送了一个空请求。这些都不收费；“测试”才会发送真实请求。

en: Looking: the model list, then an empty request to each known path…
text: 正在检测：先获取模型列表，再向每个已知路径发送空请求…

en: Give its address, and its key if it needs one. annai looks for what it offers, at no cost, then adds it with what it found.
text: 填入它的地址，需要的话再填入密钥。annai 会检测它提供哪些功能（不产生费用），然后按检测结果添加。

en: Give the server's address first, with https:// in front.
text: 请先填写服务器地址，以 https:// 开头。

en: Give the address alone, without a name and password, "?…" or "#…": a key goes in its own field.
text: 只填地址即可，不要带用户名和密码、“?…”或“#…”。密钥请填在单独的栏中。
note: Note: "a name and password" is the user name in an address (https://user:pass@…), so 用户名.

en: The key has a character no key has, such as a space or a line break: paste it again.
text: 密钥中有不该出现的字符（例如空格或换行），请重新粘贴。
它没有在 # 秒内回应。
note: plural; # = WAIT_MS / 1000; English: "It didn't answer within # second." (one), "It didn't answer within # seconds." (other)

en: It doesn't allow web apps like annai to call it (no CORS).
text: 它不允许 annai 这类网页应用调用（没有 CORS）。

en: It answered with a redirect, which annai doesn't follow.
text: 它返回了重定向，annai 不会跟随。

en: A web page answered, not an API.
text: 返回的是网页，不是 API。

en: It answers this way at any address, even one that can't exist, so annai can't tell from it.
text: 它对任何地址都这样回应，连不存在的地址也一样，所以无法据此判断。

en: It answered, but not with a list of models.
text: 它有回应，但不是模型列表。

en: The server says it doesn't do this.
text: 服务器表示不支持此功能。

en: It asks for a key before it says what it has: give the key, then look again.
text: 它要求先填入密钥，才会说明有哪些功能。请填入密钥后重新检测。

en: It refuses the key at any address, even one that can't exist, so annai can't tell from it. Check the key, then look again.
text: 它对任何地址都拒绝这个密钥，连不存在的地址也一样，所以无法据此判断。请检查密钥后重新检测。

en: It answers HTTP {0} at any address, even one that can't exist, so annai can't tell from it.
text: 它对任何地址都返回 HTTP {0}，连不存在的地址也一样，所以无法据此判断。

en: It asks for a key, and annai couldn't check whether it asks at every address: give the key, then look again.
text: 它要求提供密钥，但 annai 无法确认是否所有地址都要求密钥。请填入密钥后重新检测。

en: It refused the key, and annai couldn't check how it answers an address that can't exist. Check the key, then look again.
text: 它拒绝了这个密钥，annai 也无法确认它对不存在的地址如何回应。请检查密钥后重新检测。

en: It didn't take the key: check it.
text: 它不接受这个密钥，请检查。

en: It is busy (too many requests): look again in a minute.
text: 它正忙（请求过多），请一分钟后重新检测。

en: It had a problem of its own (HTTP {0}): look again later.
text: 它自身出了问题（HTTP {0}），请稍后重新检测。

en: It answered HTTP {0}, which says neither yes nor no.
text: 它返回了 HTTP {0}，无法据此判断是否支持。

en: Claude models through Anthropic's Messages API, with web search, and a cache that can last an hour.
text: 通过 Anthropic 的 Messages API 使用 Claude 模型，支持网页搜索，缓存最长可保留一小时。

en: DeepSeek's models, with their reasoning shown as they think.
text: DeepSeek 的模型，思考时会显示推理过程。

en: Add models with Fetch model list.
text: 用“获取模型列表”添加模型。

en: Gemini models through Google's own API, with Google Search on a paid key, its transcription and voices, and Gemini Live for a voice conversation.
text: 通过 Google 原生 API 使用 Gemini 模型。付费密钥可使用 Google 搜索，还提供 Google 的语音转文字和声音，以及可语音对话的 Gemini Live。

en: Uses Gemini's own API. AI Studio shows each key's tier: a free key's requests are limited per minute and per day. Add more models with Fetch model list.
text: 使用 Gemini 原生 API。可在 AI Studio 查看每个密钥的层级；免费密钥每分钟和每天的请求次数都有限制。可通过“获取模型列表”添加更多模型。

en: Since version 2.0 this goes through Gemini's own API, not its OpenAI-compatible endpoint. A model without a context window here was added before then, or by id: if it doesn't answer, remove it and add it again with Fetch model list.
text: 从 2.0 版起，这里改用 Gemini 原生 API，不再通过 OpenAI 兼容端点。这里没有标注上下文窗口的模型，是在此之前或按 ID 添加的；如果它没有回应，请移除后用“获取模型列表”重新添加。
note: Note: remove → 移除, as the model page's button "Remove model" (移除模型).

en: Turns what you say into text, for a model that doesn't take audio. Gemini 3.5 Transcribe is Google's own; Flash Lite writes it down when asked, for less. Their prices are estimates from Google's rates for audio, about 25 tokens a second.
text: 把语音转成文字，供不支持音频输入的模型使用。Gemini 3.5 Transcribe 是 Google 官方的语音转文字模型；Flash Lite 也能按要求转成文字，费用更低。价格是根据 Google 的音频费率（约每秒 25 个 token）估算的。

en: Shiori's voice, a sentence at a time, each sentence one request. It streams: she starts about half a second after a sentence is written, and on a weak connection she waits until it won't stutter. Switch streaming off to have each sentence arrive whole, as other voices do. On the free tier Google allows each of these voices only 10 requests a day and 3 a minute: far fewer than a day of replies, so after the first few sentences the next voice in the list speaks. Prices are estimates per character from Google's rate for audio, 25 tokens a second. Her voice is Sulafat unless the Tunables here name another (it is the warm one of Google's 30; Achird is friendly, Vindemiatrix gentle, Kore firm), and the Style goes as Google's own speech_metadata style.
text: Shiori 的声音，逐句合成，每句一次请求。采用流式播放：一句写好后约半秒她就开口；网络较差时，她会等到能流畅播放再开口。关闭流式播放后，每句会完整收到再播放，和其他声音一样。使用免费额度时，Google 对这些声音每个每天只允许 10 次请求、每分钟 3 次，远远不够一天的回复量，所以说完前几句后，会换成列表中的下一个声音。价格是根据 Google 的音频费率（每秒 25 个 token）按字符估算的。除非这里的可调参数指定了其他声音，她用的是 Sulafat（Google 30 种声音中偏温暖的一种；Achird 亲切，Vindemiatrix 温柔，Kore 坚定）；“风格”会作为 Google 的 speech_metadata 中的 style 发送。
note: Note: free tier → 免费额度, as the zh review settled ("This key is on the free tier" → 此密钥为免费额度).

en: A conversation in one stream, voice both ways, for Koe (Gemini Live). While a session is open, what you say goes to Google as audio. Free on AI Studio's free tier. Koe speaks with Sulafat here too (from the Gemini Live protocol 0.2: Settings → Updates brings it), the voice of Classic, so she sounds the same in both.
text: 供 Koe 使用的实时语音对话（Gemini Live），听和说都在同一条流中。会话开启期间，你说的话会以音频形式发送给 Google。使用 AI Studio 免费额度时不收费。这里 Koe 同样使用 Sulafat 的声音（需要 Gemini Live 协议 0.2 及以上，可在设置 → 更新中获取），与“Koe · 聊天”相同，所以两种模式下她的声音一样。
note: Note: free tier → 免费额度; "Classic" is the mode Koe · Classic (glossary Koe · 经典).

en: Fast open models, and fast Whisper transcription.
text: 开源模型和 Whisper 语音转文字，速度都很快。

en: Add models with Fetch model list.
text: 用“获取模型列表”添加模型。

en: Fast Whisper. Groq bills each request as at least 10 seconds.
text: 速度很快的 Whisper。Groq 每次请求至少按 10 秒计费。

en: Models on a llama.cpp server you run (llama-server), or one built on it such as Unsloth Studio or KoboldCpp. Their thinking is switched off for quick decisions.
text: 自己部署的 llama.cpp 服务器（llama-server）或基于它的服务器（如 Unsloth Studio、KoboldCpp）上的模型。快速判断时会关闭思考。

en: llama-server listens on port 9931 unless --port says otherwise; give it a key with --api-key, or leave the key empty. Unsloth Studio serves at its own address (port 8888 unless changed), with a key (sk-unsloth-…) from its Settings → API.
text: 除非用 --port 另行指定，llama-server 监听 9931 端口；用 --api-key 给它设密钥，或者把密钥留空。Unsloth Studio 在自己的地址上提供服务（除非改过，端口为 8888），密钥（sk-unsloth-…）在它的 Settings → API 中获取。

en: Add models with Fetch model list. For the model the server has loaded, it reads the context each conversation gets and whether the model reads images (llama-server's /props). For another, set its context window on its page (llama-server's -c, or the context length set in Unsloth Studio), and tick Takes photos if it reads images. llama-server started with --tools or --agent lets in only pages on its own computer: add annai's address with --cors-origins https://annai.guide.
text: 用“获取模型列表”添加模型。服务器当前加载的模型，会自动读取每段对话可用的上下文长度，以及能否读图（llama-server 的 /props）。其他模型请在它的页面上设置上下文窗口（llama-server 的 -c，或 Unsloth Studio 中设置的上下文长度），能读图的请勾选“支持照片”。用 --tools 或 --agent 启动的 llama-server 只允许本机的页面访问，请用 --cors-origins https://annai.guide 加入 annai 的地址。
LM Studio 服务器上的模型。

en: In LM Studio's server settings, turn on Enable CORS so annai's page may call it, and Serve on Local Network if it's reached from another computer. It listens on port 1234 unless changed. If you turned on its authentication, give its API token as the key.
text: 在 LM Studio 的服务器设置中打开 Enable CORS，annai 的页面才能调用它；如果要从另一台电脑访问，还要打开 Serve on Local Network。默认监听 1234 端口。如果开启了身份验证，请把它的 API 令牌填作密钥。

en: Add models with Fetch model list. For a model loaded in LM Studio, it reads the context it was loaded with, and whether it reads images and was trained for tool calls; for one not loaded, set its context window on its page. LM Studio doesn't document how thinking is switched: set a model's Reasoning levels on its page if it thinks.
text: 用“获取模型列表”添加模型。LM Studio 中已加载的模型，会读取加载时的上下文长度，以及能否读图、是否针对工具调用训练过；未加载的模型请在它的页面上设置上下文窗口。LM Studio 没有说明如何开关思考，所以会思考的模型请在它的页面上设置推理级别。

en: Transcription and a voice from a server you run, such as Speaches, whisper.cpp or Kokoro.
text: 用自己部署的服务器（如 Speaches、whisper.cpp 或 Kokoro）提供语音转文字和声音。

en: Speaches or whisper.cpp, at the provider's address. Add models by id, or with Fetch model list. whisper.cpp's server takes only WAV, MP3 and FLAC unless started with --convert: then set its audioIn to ["mp3", "flac", "wav"].
text: 使用提供商地址上的 Speaches 或 whisper.cpp。可按 ID 添加模型，或用“获取模型列表”。whisper.cpp 的服务器没有用 --convert 启动时只接受 WAV、MP3 和 FLAC，这时请把它的 audioIn 设为 ["mp3", "flac", "wav"]。

en: Kokoro or Speaches, at its own address. Add a voice model by id, and put one of its voices in the model's Voice (Kokoro's are such as af_heart). They take no Style: it is kept, not sent; remove "styled": false from a model's tunables for a server that does.
text: 使用单独地址上的 Kokoro 或 Speaches。按 ID 添加声音模型，并在模型的“声音”中填入它的一个声音（Kokoro 的声音如 af_heart）。它们不支持“风格”，风格会保存，但不会发送；如果服务器支持，请从模型的可调参数中删除 "styled": false。

en: Add models with Fetch model list.
text: 用“获取模型列表”添加模型。

en: Models on Ollama, with their thinking switched off for quick decisions.
text: Ollama 上的模型，快速判断时会关闭思考。

en: Ollama lets in only pages on its own computer: start it with OLLAMA_ORIGINS=https://annai.guide so annai's page may call it. It listens on port 11434.
text: Ollama 只允许同一台电脑上的页面访问。请用 OLLAMA_ORIGINS=https://annai.guide 启动它，让 annai 的页面能调用它。它监听 11434 端口。

en: Add models with Fetch model list. It reads what Ollama says of each: whether it reads images, calls tools and thinks, and its context while it is loaded (as ollama ps shows), else the num_ctx its Modelfile sets. A model that thinks gets low, medium and high; for one that can't, annai only switches thinking off, for quick decisions, as it refuses a named level. Ollama holds only 4K tokens of a conversation unless told (with under 24 GiB of video memory), far less than Shiori needs: start it with OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=64000, and set the context window of a model not loaded when you fetched the list on its page. Ollama can't be made to call a given tool, so a quick decision may go to the main model instead.
text: 用“获取模型列表”添加模型。获取时会读取 Ollama 对每个模型的说明：能否读图、能否调用工具、会不会思考，以及加载时的上下文长度（即 ollama ps 显示的值），未加载时则读取 Modelfile 设置的 num_ctx。会思考的模型可选 low、medium 和 high；不会思考的模型，Ollama 会拒绝指定级别，所以 annai 只在快速判断时关闭思考。Ollama 默认只保留 4K token 的对话（显存低于 24 GiB 时），远少于 Shiori 所需：请用 OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=64000 启动它；获取列表时没有加载的模型，请在该模型的页面上设置上下文窗口。无法强制 Ollama 调用指定工具，所以快速判断可能会改由主要模型来做。

en: GPT models through OpenAI's Responses API, with OpenAI's transcription and voices, and its live voice for Koe, on one key.
text: 通过 OpenAI 的 Responses API 使用 GPT 模型，并提供 OpenAI 的语音转文字、声音，以及供 Koe 使用的实时语音，只需一个密钥。

note: Note: Chat → 对话, as annai names the Chat ability (kindWords in src/core/llm/contract.js).

en: The one to use for OpenAI: GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol call tools only through Responses. Reasoning summaries may need a verified organization at OpenAI; without one, add "reasoningSummary": false to the tunables. A reasoning model added with Fetch model list needs its Reasoning levels set, as these models have; without them it thinks without showing progress, and may run past the time limit.
text: 使用 OpenAI 时请选这个，因为 GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 只能通过 Responses 调用工具。推理摘要可能需要 OpenAI 上已验证的组织；如果没有，请在可调参数中加入 "reasoningSummary": false。用“获取模型列表”添加的推理模型需要像这里的模型一样设置“推理级别”，否则它思考时不会显示进度，还可能超出时间限制。

note: Note: Chat → 对话, as annai names the Chat ability; Chat Completions is the protocol's name.

en: Prefer Chat (Responses): GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol call tools only there. Add models with Fetch model list.
text: 建议使用“对话（Responses）”，因为 GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 只能在那里调用工具。可用“获取模型列表”添加模型。
note: Note: Quotes the ability's own name, 对话（Responses）.

en: Turns what you say into text, for models that don't take audio.
text: 把说的话转成文字，供不支持音频的模型使用。

en: Shiori's voice. GPT-4o mini TTS is priced by audio; its price here is OpenAI's estimate of $0.015 a minute. It takes a Style (OpenAI's instructions); TTS-1 and TTS-1 HD don't, and say nothing of one. OpenAI is retiring all three on January 6, 2027.
text: Shiori 的声音。GPT-4o mini TTS 按音频计费，这里的价格是 OpenAI 估算的每分钟 $0.015。它支持“风格”（即 OpenAI 的 instructions）；TTS-1 和 TTS-1 HD 不支持，而且会直接忽略，不会报错。OpenAI 将于 2027 年 1 月 6 日停用这三个模型。

en: A conversation in one stream, voice both ways, for Koe (OpenAI Realtime). While a session is open, what you say goes to OpenAI as telephone audio (G.711, a sixth of the data of full quality; "input": "pcm16" in the tunables sends full quality), and gpt-transcribe writes it down, which OpenAI bills apart (about $0.0045 a minute) and Spend per day doesn't count. annai gives your key to OpenAI straight from the browser, where OpenAI suggests short-lived keys made by a server: if Test says the key was rejected, or the address can't be reached, while chat works with the same key, OpenAI is refusing keys from a browser, and its realtime voice would need a server, which annai doesn't have.
text: 供 Koe 使用的实时语音对话（OpenAI Realtime），听和说都在同一条流中。会话开启期间，你说的话会以电话音质发送给 OpenAI（G.711，数据量是全音质的六分之一；在可调参数中加入 "input": "pcm16" 可发送全音质），并由 gpt-transcribe 转成文字。这部分由 OpenAI 另行计费（每分钟约 $0.0045），不计入“每日花费”。annai 直接从浏览器把密钥发给 OpenAI，而 OpenAI 建议使用服务器生成的短期密钥。如果同一个密钥对话正常，但“测试”显示密钥被拒绝或地址无法访问，说明 OpenAI 拒绝了来自浏览器的密钥，这时实时语音就需要一台服务器，而 annai 没有服务器。
note: Note: chat → 对话, as annai names the Chat ability.

en: One key for many models, free ones among them, with transcription and voices too. Sign in with OpenRouter, or give a key.
text: 一个密钥就能用许多模型，其中包括免费模型，还有语音转文字和声音。可以“使用 OpenRouter 登录”，或直接填入密钥。

en: Sign in with OpenRouter is the quickest way, and it starts you on free models.
text: 最快的方式是“使用 OpenRouter 登录”，而且一开始会先用免费模型。

en: One key for many providers. Free models allow 50 requests a day (1,000 a day after $10 of credits). Its transcription and voices use the same key: none of the transcription models is free, and Fish Audio's free voice uses one of the free requests a day for each sentence it says. The others need credits you buy at OpenRouter.
text: 一个密钥即可使用许多提供商。免费模型每天可请求 50 次（充值 $10 后为每天 1,000 次）。语音转文字和声音也用同一个密钥。语音转文字模型都不免费；Fish Audio 的免费声音每说一句，就会占用一次每日免费请求。其余的都需要用你在 OpenRouter 充值的余额支付。
note: Note: Credits are a prepaid balance (余额), as the zh review settled; "The others" are every speech model but Fish Audio's free voice, so 其余的, not only the voices.

en: Turns what you say into text, for models that don't take audio. The prices are OpenRouter's lowest; it may send a request to a provider that charges more.
text: 把你说的话转成文字，供不支持音频输入的模型使用。这里显示的是 OpenRouter 上的最低价；OpenRouter 可能会把请求转给收费更高的提供商。

en: Shiori's voice. Each model has voices of its own, suggested in the model's Voice (Fetch model list brings the ones OpenRouter lists). The voice and style set here are Women KatKat, a voice from Fish Audio's library (friendly, clear, young and bright), and a young, cheerful and lively, yet calm and gentle style: every Fish Audio model starts with them, those described below and any added by id (sent no voice, Fish Audio picks another speaker for each sentence). A model added from the list starts with the first warm voice OpenRouter lists for it. Only Fish Audio, Gemini and OpenAI's gpt-4o-mini-tts take a Style; for the others it is kept, not sent. OpenRouter sends MP3 or PCM only.
text: Shiori 的声音。每个模型都有自己的一组声音，可在模型的“声音”中看到推荐（“获取模型列表”会带入 OpenRouter 列出的声音）。这里设定的声音是 Fish Audio 声音库中的 Women KatKat（亲切、清晰、年轻明亮），风格是年轻、欢快活泼，同时沉稳温柔。所有 Fish Audio 模型，无论是下面列出的，还是按 ID 添加的，都默认使用它们（如果不发送声音，Fish Audio 每句话都会换一个说话人）。从列表添加的模型，默认使用 OpenRouter 为它列出的第一个温暖的声音。只有 Fish Audio、Gemini 和 OpenAI 的 gpt-4o-mini-tts 支持“风格”；其他模型会保留风格设置，但不会发送。OpenRouter 只返回 MP3 或 PCM 格式。
note: Note: "the model's Voice" is the model page's Voice field, 声音 (b1qn4p), not the Settings → Voice screen.

en: Tap Sign in with OpenRouter to start again.
text: 请轻点“使用 OpenRouter 登录”重新开始。

en: Paste the code OpenRouter showed you, then tap Connect.
text: 请粘贴 OpenRouter 显示的代码，然后轻点“连接”。

en: annai has no sign-in waiting for this code: it was used already, or began in another browser.
text: 找不到等待这个代码的登录。代码可能已经用过，或者登录是在另一个浏览器中发起的。

en: This sign-in didn't start in this browser, so annai ignored it.
text: 这次登录不是在这个浏览器中发起的，所以已忽略。

en: annai couldn't reach OpenRouter. Check the connection and try again.
text: 无法连接 OpenRouter。请检查网络连接后重试。

en: OpenRouter answered with a redirect, which annai doesn't follow with your sign-in.
text: OpenRouter 返回了重定向；annai 不会带着你的登录信息跟随重定向。

en: OpenRouter didn't take the code: a code works once, for 10 minutes. Tap Sign in with OpenRouter to get a new one.
text: OpenRouter 不接受这个代码。代码只能使用一次，10 分钟内有效。请轻点“使用 OpenRouter 登录”获取新代码。

en: Nothing was sent to OpenRouter yet: try again.
text: 尚未向 OpenRouter 发送任何内容，请重试。

en: annai keeps the new key for OpenRouter's chat, transcription and voices.
text: 新密钥已保存，将用于 OpenRouter 的对话、语音转文字和声音。
note: Note: chat → 对话, as annai names the Chat ability.

en: Shiori thinks with free models to start, so trying annai costs nothing. annai also added OpenRouter's transcription and voices, behind the phone's own dictation and the browser voice. Its free voice comes first: each sentence it says uses one of the free requests a day the chat models use too. The others cost a little, from credits you buy at OpenRouter. To use them first, move them up under Roles.
text: Shiori 一开始会用免费模型思考，所以试用 annai 不花钱。annai 还添加了 OpenRouter 的语音转文字和声音，排在手机自带的语音输入和浏览器声音之后。其中免费声音排在最前，它每说一句，就会占用一次每日免费请求（对话模型也共用这些请求）。其他声音要花一点钱，从你在 OpenRouter 充值的余额中扣除。想优先使用它们，请在“角色”中把它们往上移。
note: Note: Credits → 余额 (a prepaid balance), as the zh review settled; the phone's dictation → 手机语音输入, as annai's own rows.

en: OpenRouter opens in Safari. Sign in there; it then shows a code, which works for 10 minutes. Copy it, come back to annai, and paste it here.
text: OpenRouter 会在 Safari 浏览器中打开。登录后会显示一个代码，10 分钟内有效。复制代码，回到 annai，粘贴到这里。

en: Paste the code OpenRouter showed you
text: 粘贴 OpenRouter 显示的代码

en: annai has made a new sign-in: tap it again.
text: 已准备好新的登录，请再轻点一次。

en: annai has made a new sign-in: tap Sign in with OpenRouter again.
text: 已准备好新的登录，请再轻点一次“使用 OpenRouter 登录”。

en: Sign in again for a new key, in place of the one saved.
text: 重新登录可获取新密钥，替换已保存的密钥。

en: Sign in with OpenRouter for a key, or give one below.
text: 可以“使用 OpenRouter 登录”获取密钥，或在下方直接填入。

en: Sign in with OpenRouter to get one key for many models. annai starts you on free models (50 requests a day), so trying it costs nothing. It also adds OpenRouter's transcription and voices, a free one among them; the phone's own dictation and voice stay first.
text: “使用 OpenRouter 登录”后，一个密钥就能用许多模型。annai 会先让你用免费模型（每天 50 次请求），所以试用不花钱。同时还会添加 OpenRouter 的语音转文字和声音（其中有一个免费声音）；手机自带的语音输入和声音仍排在前面。
note: Note: The phone's dictation → 语音输入, as annai's own rows (Phone dictation → 手机语音输入).
Note: annai's own rows call it 脚本模型 (Simulate: "A scripted model (Settings → Models) makes it free").

en: A model that replies from a script, for tests and plugin authors. It never uses the network.
text: 按脚本回复的模型，供测试和插件开发者使用，完全不联网。

en: Models on an SGLang server you run, with their thinking switched through the chat template.
text: 自己部署的 SGLang 服务器上的模型，通过聊天模板开启或关闭思考模式。

en: SGLang listens on port 30000 unless --port says otherwise; give it a key with --api-key, or leave the key empty.
text: SGLang 默认监听 30000 端口，可用 --port 另行指定；可以用 --api-key 设置密钥，也可以把密钥留空。

en: Add models with Fetch model list: each comes with the context the server holds. Tool calls need --tool-call-parser <name>, and a model that thinks needs --reasoning-parser <name>; without them Shiori can't use her tools, and her thinking shows in her words.
text: 用“获取模型列表”添加模型，每个模型都会带上服务器设定的上下文长度。工具调用需要 --tool-call-parser <name>，会思考的模型需要 --reasoning-parser <name>；缺少这些参数，Shiori 就无法使用工具，她的思考内容也会混进回答里。

en: Models on a vLLM server you run, with their thinking switched through the chat template, and Whisper models for transcription.
text: 自己部署的 vLLM 服务器上的模型，通过聊天模板开启或关闭思考模式；也支持用于语音转文字的 Whisper 模型。

en: vLLM listens on port 8000 unless --port says otherwise; give it a key with --api-key, or leave the key empty.
text: vLLM 默认监听 8000 端口，可用 --port 另行指定；可以用 --api-key 设置密钥，也可以把密钥留空。

en: Add models with Fetch model list: each comes with the context the server holds. Tool calls need --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser <name>, and a model that thinks needs --reasoning-parser <name>; without them Shiori can't use her tools, and her thinking shows in her words.
text: 用“获取模型列表”添加模型，每个模型都会带上服务器设定的上下文长度。工具调用需要 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser <name>，会思考的模型需要 --reasoning-parser <name>；缺少这些参数，Shiori 就无法使用工具，她的思考内容也会混进回答里。

en: For a Whisper model on a vLLM server of its own: give that server's address as this ability's own, and add the model by id.
text: 如果 Whisper 模型运行在另一台 vLLM 服务器上，请把那台服务器的地址设为此功能单独使用的地址，再按 ID 添加模型。

note: Note: As annai's own Experimental row names it (远程记录（开发者）); Trace is the glossary's 记录.

en: For developers: sends annai's trace, as the Trace screen shows it, to a server you run, while you watch. It sends nothing until you give it a server and a token and turn Send on. The keys annai keeps are blanked.
text: 供开发者使用：把 annai 的记录按“记录”页面的样子实时发送到你自己部署的服务器。填好服务器和令牌并打开“发送”之前，什么都不会发送。annai 保存的密钥会被遮盖。

en: Where annai sends its trace: a server you run, such as annai's scripts/trace-sink.mjs. https://…, or http:// only for localhost or 127.0.0.1.
text: 接收 annai 记录的服务器，由你自己部署，例如 annai 的 scripts/trace-sink.mjs。须以 https:// 开头，http:// 仅限 localhost 或 127.0.0.1。

en: The server's token. annai sends it as Authorization: Bearer, and keeps it with your keys, never in a file.
text: 服务器的令牌。annai 以 Authorization: Bearer 的形式发送，和其他密钥保存在一起，不会写进文件。

en: Also send the location points annai records while GPS is on, about one a second on a drive. Off, other entries can still name a place, as the Trace shows them: a weather request's address, a tool's input.
text: 同时发送 GPS 开启时 annai 记录的位置点（开车时约每秒一个）。关闭后，其他条目仍可能提到地点，和“记录”中显示的一样，例如天气请求的地址、工具的输入。

en: On, what the Trace records from now on goes to the server within a few seconds: what you write, what Shiori says, her tools, requests and errors. The keys annai keeps are blanked, and stored content (photos, long texts) stays here. Off stops it at once.
text: 开启后，“记录”此后记下的内容会在几秒内发送到服务器，包括你写的内容、Shiori 说的话、她用的工具、请求和错误。annai 保存的密钥会被遮盖，已存储的内容（照片、长文本）会留在本机。关闭后立即停止。

en: Also sends recordings of what the microphone heard to the server above: each of your turns, and short samples of sound the level check kept out. Recordings include passengers and whatever is playing. Phone dictation is the browser's own, so it has no audio. A text copy of the screen goes too, at each screen change and when you tap Flag, without what's typed in fields or the keys annai keeps, and never from the Trace screen. A Flag button takes the Trace chip's place in the dock, to mark when something looks wrong. It needs a server address and Send on, and turns itself off after 24 hours.
text: 同时把麦克风录到的声音发送到上面的服务器：你每次说的话，以及被音量检查过滤掉的简短声音片段。录音中会有乘客的声音和正在播放的内容。使用手机语音输入时由浏览器自行处理，所以没有录音。屏幕上的文字也会发送一份，在每次切换画面和你轻点“标记”时发送，但不含输入框里的内容和 annai 保存的密钥，也不会发送“记录”页面。底栏中的“记录”按钮会换成“标记”按钮，发现异常时可以点它做标记。需要填写服务器地址并打开“发送”，24 小时后会自动关闭。

en: Sent with each batch, so the server can tell this device from another. annai makes one at the first send; you may give it a name of your own.
text: 会随每批数据一起发送，方便服务器区分不同设备。annai 会在第一次发送时自动生成，你也可以自己起个名字。

en: It needs the address of your server.
Its server address must start with https:// (http:// only for localhost or 127.0.0.1).
text: 服务器地址必须以 https:// 开头（http:// 只能用于 localhost 或 127.0.0.1）。

en: Its server address has a name or password in it, which a request can't carry. Take it out, and give the server's token as the Token.
text: 服务器地址里含有用户名或密码，请求无法带上这些信息。请删掉它们，并把服务器的令牌填在“令牌”里。
note: Note: "a name or password" in an address is its user name (https://user:pass@…), so 用户名.

en: Change it in Settings → Plugins → Remote trace (for developers).
text: 请在设置 → 插件 → 远程记录（开发者）中更改。
note: Note: Settings paths sit in the sentence without spaces, as annai's rows write them.

en: annai couldn't get the batch ready.

text: 正在发送记录，# 条待发送。
note: plural; # = waiting; English: "Sending trace: # waiting." (one), "Sending trace: # waiting." (other)

en: It needs the server's token. Add it in Settings → Plugins → Remote trace (for developers).
text: 需要服务器的令牌。请在设置 → 插件 → 远程记录（开发者）中添加。

en: Its token has characters a request can't carry: letters, digits and punctuation only, no spaces.
text: 令牌含有无法发送的字符。只能包含字母、数字和标点，不能有空格。

en: The trace server refuses what annai sends
{0} answered {1} {2} times in a row: the token may be wrong.
text: {0} 连续 {2} 次返回了 {1}，令牌可能有误。

en: annai keeps trying about once a minute, and keeps the newest {0} entries until they go. Check the server address and the token in Settings → Plugins → Remote trace (for developers), or turn Send off there.
text: annai 会每分钟左右重试一次，并保留最新的 {0} 条记录，直到发送成功。请在设置 → 插件 → 远程记录（开发者）中检查服务器地址和令牌，或在那里关闭“发送”。

en: It stops after 24 hours, so it can't be forgotten.
text: 24 小时后会自动停止，以免忘了关闭。

en: The server address changed, and recordings go only where you turned it on.
text: 服务器地址已更改，录音只会发送到开启时所用的地址。

en: It needs a server address and Send on. Set those, then turn it on.
text: 需要先填好服务器地址并打开“发送”，再开启详细记录。

note: Note: annai's own rows call it 脚本模型 (Simulate).

en: A model that replies from a script, for tests and plugin authors. It never uses the network.
text: 按脚本回复的模型，供测试和插件开发者使用，完全不联网。

note: Note: annai translates its own plugins' descriptive word (decision 10): Search → 搜索; annai's credits rows name Tavily's and Serper's the same way.

en: Searches through a SearXNG instance you run. No key, no limits but your own. The instance must allow JSON and web apps.
text: 通过自己部署的 SearXNG 实例搜索。无需密钥，限制完全由你自己设定。该实例必须允许 JSON 格式和网页应用访问。

en: Like https://search.example.com. In the instance's settings.yml, put json under search: formats:, and have its web server send Access-Control-Allow-Origin for annai's address. Plain http works only for localhost.
text: 例如 https://search.example.com。在实例的 settings.yml 里，把 json 加到 search: formats: 下，并让它的 Web 服务器发送允许 annai 地址的 Access-Control-Allow-Origin 标头。不加密的 http 只能用于 localhost。
note: Note: Access-Control-Allow-Origin is a header's name, kept as written; not the phone's Allow.

en: needs the address of your instance (Settings → Plugins → SearXNG Search)
text: 需要填写实例地址（设置 → 插件 → SearXNG 搜索）

note: Note: annai translates its own plugins' descriptive word (decision 10): Search → 搜索, as the credits row now names it.

en: Google's results through Serper, with its answer box. 2,500 free searches on sign-up, no card.
text: 通过 Serper 获取 Google 搜索结果，含答案框。注册即送 2,500 次免费搜索，无需绑卡。
note: Note: "no card" is a payment card: 银行卡, not the glossary's card (卡片).

en: 2,500 free searches on sign-up, no card.
text: 注册即送 2,500 次免费搜索，无需绑卡。
note: Note: "no card" is a payment card: 银行卡, not the glossary's card (卡片).

en: needs a key (Settings → Plugins → Serper Search)
text: 需要密钥（设置 → 插件 → Serper 搜索）

note: Note: annai translates its own plugins' descriptive word (decision 10): Search → 搜索, as the credits row now names it.

en: Web search made for AI agents, with a snippet of each page. 1,000 free credits a month, no card.
text: 专为 AI 智能体打造的网页搜索，附带每个页面的摘要。每月免费 1,000 积分，无需绑卡。
note: Note: "no card" is a payment card: 银行卡, not the glossary's card (卡片). Tavily's credits are a monthly allowance, not a prepaid balance, so 额度, not 余额.

en: A free key gives 1,000 credits a month, no card. A basic search costs 1 credit, an advanced one 2.
text: 免费密钥每月有 1,000 积分，无需绑卡。基本搜索消耗 1 积分，深入搜索消耗 2 积分。
note: Note: "no card" is a payment card: 银行卡. Tavily's credits are a monthly allowance, so 额度, not 余额.

en: Basic costs 1 credit a search; advanced reads deeper for 2.

en: First make a new private repository on the server for annai's backups: annai doesn't make one. Then make an access token for it (your Settings, then Applications) with Repository: Read and write, and paste it here. Leave Owner and Repository empty, and annai finds the private repository the token can change. The token stays on this device; it is never in a backup. On Codeberg, the server address is https://codeberg.org.

note: Note: Settings → Applications and Repository: Read and write are Forgejo's own English names, kept as written.

en: The server must let web apps at {0} use its API. Add these lines to its app.ini, then restart it. Codeberg allows this already.
text: 服务器必须允许来自 {0} 的网页应用使用它的 API。请把以下几行加入它的 app.ini，然后重启服务器。Codeberg 已默认允许。

en: What Shiori's model calls may cost in a day, in all your trips. Once it is spent, her turn ends with a card, and she goes on the next day. Empty: no limit.

en: Providers keep the start of the conversation for a while, so her next request costs less. An hour costs more to write than five minutes, and pays off when you talk less often than every few minutes. A model that keeps it only five minutes is asked for five.
text: 提供商会把对话开头缓存一段时间，让她的下一个请求更便宜。缓存一小时的写入费用比五分钟高，但如果你说话的间隔超过几分钟，选一小时更划算。只支持缓存五分钟的模型会按五分钟请求。

en: When a conversation gets long, Shiori summarizes its older part. She does it when it reaches this share of her model's context, or when a request would get this big. Empty: the usual.

en: Summarize at a share from 50 to 90%.

en: The largest request is from 1 to 64 MiB.

text: 浏览器自带的声音。部分声音在本机朗读；标有“在线”的会把她的话发送到相应的服务。

en: This browser has no voice of its own.
text: 此浏览器没有自带声音。

en: The speed goes from 0.5 (slow) to 2 (fast); 1 is normal.
text: 速度范围为 0.5（慢）到 2（快），1 为正常速度。

note: context: section; Note: Settings → Voice's section on how annai hears you (the glossary's Speech in), not Shiori's state.

en: annai hears that you finished a sentence when you pause. A longer pause lets you think mid-sentence; a shorter one answers sooner.
text: 你一停顿，annai 就认为这句话说完了。停顿时间设长一点，说到一半可以停下来想想；设短一点，回应更快。

en: The pause goes from 300 to 3000 milliseconds; 700 is the usual.
text: 停顿范围为 300 到 3000 毫秒，一般为 700。

en: Off: what the microphone hears is sent to be written down, then let go. On: each clip is kept with the conversation, and in backups.
text: 关闭：麦克风录到的声音发去转成文字后即丢弃。开启：每段语音都随对话保存，也会包含在备份中。

en: Live on: Shiori hears you and answers in one stream, with a live model. Live off: what you say is written down, then answered. The Live chip on the dock switches it.
text: 实时开启：Shiori 用实时模型在同一条音频流中听你说话并回答。实时关闭：先把你说的话转成文字，再回答。底栏的“实时”按钮可以切换。

en: While a live session listens, what you say goes straight to {0} as audio, only while someone speaks, and the chip says "Listening live". It closes after the time below with no exchange, when she's asked to sleep, on voice off, or when annai leaves the screen. With sound that never stops, such as music, Shiori decides when to sleep.
text: 实时会话收听时，你说的话会以音频形式直接发送给 {0}（仅在有人说话时发送），按钮上会显示“正在实时收听”。超过下方设定的时间没有交流、你让她睡觉、关闭语音，或 annai 离开屏幕时，会话就会结束。如果一直有声音（比如音乐），由 Shiori 决定什么时候睡觉。
note: {0} = list(live, 'or'); Note: "on voice off" is the glossary's Voice off mode (关闭语音).

en: While a live session listens, what you say goes straight to its provider as audio, only while someone speaks, and the chip says "Listening live". It closes after the time below with no exchange, when she's asked to sleep, on voice off, or when annai leaves the screen. With sound that never stops, such as music, Shiori decides when to sleep.
text: 实时会话收听时，你说的话会以音频形式直接发送给它的提供商（仅在有人说话时发送），按钮上会显示“正在实时收听”。超过下方设定的时间没有交流、你让她睡觉、关闭语音，或 annai 离开屏幕时，会话就会结束。如果一直有声音（比如音乐），由 Shiori 决定什么时候睡觉。
note: Note: "on voice off" is the glossary's Voice off mode (关闭语音).

en: While she listens, set her voice's volume with the iPhone's volume buttons: iPhone may keep it apart from the volume of music and videos.
text: 她在听的时候，请用 iPhone 的音量键调节她的音量。iPhone 可能会把它和音乐、视频的音量分开。

en: Close after 10 to 300 seconds with no exchange.
Close a live session after (seconds with no exchange)
text: 多久无交流后结束实时会话（秒）

en: Only with headphones or car audio: on the phone's own speaker the microphone hears her, so there only a tap cuts her off. Off: only a tap, everywhere, for a car whose speakers echo her voice back.
text: 仅在使用耳机或车载音响时有效。用手机扬声器时，麦克风会听到她的声音，所以只能轻点打断。关闭：无论在哪里都只能轻点打断，适合扬声器会把她的声音传回麦克风的车。

en: The chip on the dock turns GPS on and off. Keeping the screen on uses more battery; without it, a locked phone stops following where you are.
text: 底栏的 GPS 按钮可以开启或关闭 GPS。屏幕常亮会更耗电；但不开的话，手机锁屏后就无法继续追踪你的位置。

en: What you say goes to the first of these that can hear it; what she says, to the first voice that works. To change the order, go to {0}.
text: 你说的话会交给下面第一个能识别的；她说的话，由第一个能用的声音朗读。要调整顺序，请前往{0}。

en: To keep your voice on the phone, type with your keyboard's microphone key: iPhone and most Android keyboards can dictate on the phone itself.
text: 如果不想让语音离开手机，请用键盘上的麦克风键输入。iPhone 和大多数 Android 键盘都能在本机完成语音输入。
note: Note: "microphone key" is a keyboard key (麦克风键), not an API key (密钥); "your voice" is your own speech.

en: annai is a free, open-source travel guide that lives on your phone.
text: annai 是装在你手机里的免费开源旅行向导。

en: Its guide is Shiori. She plans the trip with you, keeps your bookings and notes, reminds you at the right time and place, talks with you on the road, and makes a recap afterwards.
text: 向导名叫 Shiori。她会和你一起规划旅行，保管预订和笔记，在合适的时间和地点提醒你，一路上陪你聊天，旅行结束后还会帮你做回顾。

en: Tap + on Trips to talk to her, or tap her in any conversation.
text: 在“旅行”中轻点 + 就能和她对话，也可以在任何对话中轻点她。
note: Note: The Trips screen, quoted so it reads apart from a trip, as in 前往“旅行” (Go to Trips).

en: annai (案内) is Japanese for "guidance; showing someone around".
text: annai（案内）是日语，意思是“引导、带人四处参观”。

en: Shiori is your guide. She has two halves that work together.
text: Shiori 是你的向导。她分为 Koe 和 Kokoro 两部分，彼此配合。

note: {0} = KOE; Note: {0} is 声, Koe's name in Japanese; ja needs no gloss.

en: talks with you and answers at once.
note: Note: follows Koe's name in bold: "Koe (声, voice) talks with you…".
{0} = KOKORO; Note: {0} is 心, Kokoro's name in Japanese; ja needs no gloss.

en: thinks things through and does the work: planning, searching, reading your bookings.
text: 仔细思考，把事情办好：规划、搜索、查看你的预订。
note: Note: follows Kokoro's name in bold.

en: You only talk to Shiori. While Kokoro works, Koe keeps you company, and tells you when Kokoro has the answer. What they tell each other shows in the conversation; Settings → Shiori can hide it.
text: 你只需要和 Shiori 说话。Kokoro 忙的时候，Koe 会陪着你，等 Kokoro 有了答案再告诉你。两者之间的交流会显示在对话中，可在设置 → Shiori 中隐藏。

en: Plan the trip day by day with Shiori, and add your confirmations: PDFs, Wallet passes, screenshots. You book; annai never books for you.
text: 和 Shiori 一起逐日安排行程，并添加预订确认：PDF、钱包卡券、截图。预订由你自己来，annai 从不替你预订。

en: With GPS on, annai follows where you are and reminds you at the right time and place: when to leave, when you've arrived, when you're running late.
text: 开启 GPS 后，annai 会实时定位，在合适的时间和地点提醒你：该出发了、已经到了、快要迟到了。

en: Talk with Shiori hands-free, in the car or on a trail.
text: 在车上或徒步时，都能免提和 Shiori 对话。

en: OpenStreetMap places, Wikipedia summaries and Wikivoyage guides along your itinerary, for when there's no signal.
text: 行程沿途的 OpenStreetMap 地点、Wikipedia 摘要和 Wikivoyage 指南，没有信号时也能查看。

en: Show Shiori what you see, and ask about it.
text: 把你看到的拍给 Shiori，问问她。

en: Export a file, or back up automatically to GitHub, a Forgejo or Gitea server, an S3 bucket or a WebDAV folder.
text: 导出为文件，或自动备份到 GitHub、Forgejo 或 Gitea 服务器、S3 存储桶或 WebDAV 文件夹。
插件和 MCP 服务器。

en: Skills, tools and screens that others make.
text: 别人制作的技能、工具和界面。

en: Afterwards, a recap of the trip, and its route played back.
text: 旅行结束后，可以看旅行回顾，还能回放路线。

en: annai is built so your keys and data stay yours. Here is exactly how, and where that stops.
text: annai 的设计确保你的密钥和数据始终属于你。下面具体说明如何做到，以及哪些情况下做不到。

en: Shiori can search the web as soon as you start, through free services. No key, nothing to set up.
text: Shiori 一开始就能通过免费服务上网搜索，无需密钥，也不用设置。

en: These are on. Untick any you would rather not use.
text: 这些已开启。不想用的可以取消勾选。

en: A model set up here, in Safari, stays in Safari.
text: 在这里（Safari 浏览器）设置的模型只会留在 Safari 浏览器中。

en: Connect a model, so Shiori can think.
text: 连接一个模型，Shiori 就能思考了。

en: Connect a model there, so Shiori can think.
text: 在那里连接一个模型，Shiori 就能思考了。

en: You can also install annai as an app from your browser's menu.
text: 你也可以从浏览器菜单把 annai 安装为应用。

en: Safari can erase what annai keeps after 7 days without a visit, and the Home Screen app keeps data of its own. Add annai to your Home Screen, and set up your model there.
text: 如果 7 天没有打开，Safari 浏览器可能会清除 annai 保存的内容；主屏幕上的 App 则有自己独立的数据。请把 annai 添加到主屏幕，并在那里设置模型。

en: Your browser may clear what annai keeps when space runs low. Install annai to keep your trips safe.
text: 存储空间不足时，浏览器可能会清除 annai 保存的内容。安装 annai 可以保护你的旅行数据。

en: Then, in the Home Screen app
text: 然后，在主屏幕上的 App 中

en: Free search sends your searches to Exa, Parallel or Firecrawl: just the words searched, not your files or your location. Exa also reads a page that no other reader can, which sends it that page's address. They are free tiers that can change or stop, and Exa and Parallel may use what is searched to train their models, so keep names and addresses out of your searches. Behind them, a last resort that is always on asks Wikimedia (Wikivoyage and Wikipedia) and OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) the same words; only Search via: Off stops it.
text: 免费搜索只会把搜索的关键词发送给 Exa、Parallel 或 Firecrawl，不会发送你的文件或位置。遇到其他方式读取不了的网页时，还会交给 Exa 读取，这样 Exa 也会收到该网页的地址。这些都是免费额度，随时可能变动或停止；而且 Exa 和 Parallel 可能用搜索内容训练自己的模型，所以搜索时请不要包含姓名和地址。在它们之后，还有一个始终开启的最后备选，会用同样的关键词查询 Wikimedia（Wikivoyage 和 Wikipedia）和 OpenStreetMap（Nominatim）；只有把“搜索方式”设为“关闭”才能停用它。
note: Note: "Search via: Off" as the choice is named on this screen.

en: Only the words she searches for go to the ones you leave ticked, and Exa also gets the addresses of pages it reads for her: not your files or your location. They're free tiers that can change or stop, and Exa and Parallel may use searches to train their models, so keep names and addresses out of them. Behind them, Wikimedia (Wikivoyage and Wikipedia) and OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) are always asked as a last resort; only Settings → Tools → Search via: Off stops that. You can change all this there.
text: 只有她搜索的关键词会发送给你保留勾选的服务；Exa 替她读取网页时，也会收到这些网页的地址。你的文件和位置都不会发送。这些都是免费额度，随时可能变动或停止；而且 Exa 和 Parallel 可能用搜索内容训练自己的模型，所以搜索时请不要包含姓名和地址。在它们之后，始终会查询 Wikimedia（Wikivoyage 和 Wikipedia）和 OpenStreetMap（Nominatim）作为最后备选；只有在设置 → 工具中把“搜索方式”设为“关闭”才能停止。这些都可以在那里更改。

en: Wikimedia and OpenStreetMap; always on, the last resort
text: Wikimedia 和 OpenStreetMap；始终开启，作为最后备选

en: web_search tries these from the top, and the first that answers wins. One that fails rests for a while, then is tried again. Untick one to stop using it.
text: web_search 会从上往下依次尝试，采用第一个给出结果的服务。失败的服务会暂停一段时间，之后再试。取消勾选即可停用。

en: More search providers are plugins: add one from the catalog (Tavily, Serper, your own SearXNG), and its key goes on its own page.
text: 其他搜索提供商以插件形式提供，可从目录中添加（Tavily、Serper、自建的 SearXNG），密钥在插件自己的页面上填写。

en: It will be used the next time annai starts.
text: 下次启动 annai 时生效。

en: Hello! This is how I sound when I talk to you.
text: 你好！我跟你说话时就是这个声音。
note: Note: spoken by the voice being tested, so it is heard in the screens' language.

en: It works: that was this voice.
text: 可以使用，刚才听到的就是这个声音。

en: Say something, such as "Where should we stop for lunch?"
text: 请说句话，比如“我们在哪儿停下来吃午饭？”

en: Nothing was heard in 12 seconds. Check that the microphone is on, then try again.
text: 12 秒内没听到声音。请确认麦克风已开启，然后再试一次。

en: It heard speech but wrote nothing down. Try again, a little closer to the phone.
text: 听到了说话声，但没有识别出任何文字。请靠近手机一点再试一次。

en: Nothing was half-saved. To make room, remove a trip you no longer need (back it up first), or free up space on this device.
text: 未保存任何不完整的内容。要腾出空间，请移除不再需要的旅行（先备份），或清理此设备上的空间。

en: A short conversation with this model alone: if it fails, no other model answers. Each reply shows its tokens and cost. Nothing is kept but the Trace.
text: 只与这个模型简短对话，它失败时不会改用其他模型。每条回复都会显示 token 数和费用。除了“记录”，不会保存任何内容。

en: GPS is off, so annai isn't following where you are.
text: GPS 已关闭，annai 不会追踪你的位置。

en: Location isn't allowed for annai. Open Driving to say where you are.
text: annai 没有位置权限。请到“驾驶中”告诉它你在哪里。

text: 检查超时。请检查网络连接后重试。

en: annai's offline service hasn't started yet, so annai itself wasn't checked. Try again in a moment.
text: annai 的离线服务尚未启动，因此没有检查 annai 本身。请稍后重试。

en: annai couldn't check for a new version of itself. Check the connection and try again.
text: 无法检查 annai 是否有新版本。请检查网络连接后重试。

en: The download of the new version didn't finish. annai tries again the next time it checks.
text: 新版本没有下载完成。annai 会在下次检查时重试。

en: annai restarts once Shiori has finished
text: 等 Shiori 忙完后，annai 会重启

en: She is in the middle of something, and an update never lands during her turn. Tap her to stop her now.
text: 她正在忙，更新要等她忙完才会进行。轻点她即可让她立即停下。
